title: El calor
goal: Sit on a bench and talk about the weather and nothing else
culture: The heat is not small talk you have to get past — it is the conversation. A doña on a shaded bench expects nothing from you but agreement, and agreeing well is how a stranger turns into somebody she recognises tomorrow.

beats.es: Buenas tardes. Siéntese aquí, mijo, que hay sombra.
beats.objective: Sit down and say how hot it is
beats.good: ¡Qué calor! is closer to a greeting than a complaint. Say it and you have said exactly the right thing.

beats.es: Uh, y así es todo el año. En abril es peor, fíjese.
beats.en: That’s how it is. Every day.
ok: asi es todos los dias ni modo
beats.good: Así es is the whole agreement. It sits where English puts "you’re telling me", and it never sounds like flattery.

beats.es: Y no llueve. Se secó todo el patio, mire.
beats.en: Nothing to be done. That’s how it is.
beats.good: Ni modo closes a complaint without arguing with it. Offering a solution here would be the odd thing to do.
